Just Mushrooms products are complementary health products. They have not been evaluated by the South African Health Products Regulatory Authority (SAHPRA) for quality, safety or intended use, and they are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease.

Information on this website, including species pages, is provided for general education. It summarises published research with an evidence tier for each statement and is not medical advice. Research on functional mushrooms is early and mostly based on small, short studies, often using preparations that differ from a tincture.

Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, taking any medication, have a medical condition, or are giving a product to a child. Do not use if you are allergic to mushrooms or alcohol. Products contain approximately 30% ethanol.

Pet products: for animal use only; consult a veterinarian and do not use as a substitute for veterinary care.

If you experience an adverse reaction, stop use and seek medical advice. You can also report it to SAHPRA.
